1. (Currently amended) An air braking unit for use in an air braking system, the air braking unit being arranged to be positioned, in use, at a vehicle wheel, and comprising: an inlet for receiving, in use, compressed air from a central source; at least one first valve arranged to selectively allow compressed air from the inlet to enter a wheel brake chamber in use; at least one second valve arranged to selectively allow air from the brake chamber to be released via an outlet to the atmosphere in use; and control means for controlling the first and second valves to operate to selectively control the air pressure in the brake chamber in use, __wherein the control means comprises a microprocessor-based electronic control unit arranged to modulate the first and second valves based on real-time feedback from sensors to achieve a target braking force__.

2. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 1, further comprising __at least two__ plural first valves and/or plural second valves __that are independently controlled by the control means__.

3. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 2, wherein the plural valves may comprise one or more larger valves arranged to allow large volumes of air to pass therethrough and one or more smaller valves arranged to allow passage of smaller volumes of air therethrough, __wherein the larger and smaller valves are operated in a coordinated sequence to modulate brake pressure__.

4. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of claim 3, wherein the one or more smaller valves are arranged to operate at high speed, __and wherein the larger valves are arranged to operate at lower speeds than the smaller valves__.

5. (Currently amended) The air braking unit of any preceding claim, wherein one or more of the valves are driven by __solenoid actuators that are pulse-width modulated to provide proportional control of air flow__.

6. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to any preceding claim, wherein the control means is arranged to receive control signals from a wheel speed sensor and an air pressure sensor for determining the pressure in the brake chamber, __and wherein the control means is further arranged to calculate a target brake pressure based on the wheel speed and air pressure signals and to adjust the first and second valves to achieve the target brake pressure__.

7. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6, wherein the control means is arranged to receive data from a vehicle speed sensor, and reference data indicative of an optimum braking force for given vehicle and wheel speeds and control braking force based thereon, __wherein the reference data is stored in a lookup table within the microprocessor-based electronic control unit__.

8. (Currently amended) An air braking unit according to claim 6 or claim 7, wherein the control means is arranged to determine, from the sensors, and stored reference data, an optimum speed for each wheel and to control the braking force on each wheel in accordance with the calculated optimum speed, __wherein the control means implements an anti-lock braking algorithm that prevents wheel lockup by modulating brake pressure in real-time__.

9. (Currently amended) An air braking system comprising one or more units according to any preceding claim; a pump for generating compressed air; and a central compressed air storage tank, __wherein the pump is controlled by the microprocessor-based electronic control unit to maintain a minimum pressure in the storage tank__.
